image_description: A close-up underwater shot of a lionfish (Pterois) swimming near coral. The fish displays characteristic reddish-brown and white vertical stripes, large fan-like pectoral fins with elongated rays, and prominent dorsal spines. The background consists of textured coral reef structures in green and brown hues.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large head with prominent eyes and wide mouth.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head is visible on the left side of the frame. While the angle is slightly from behind/side, the large eye and general head shape consistent with Scorpaenidae are visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Laterally compressed body with moderately sized proportions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The body appears laterally compressed, typical for this species, though partially obscured by the spread pectoral fin.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Brightly striped coloration in red, white, brown, or black bands.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Distinct vertical bands of dark reddish-brown and white are clearly visible on the body and fins.
The image resolution and underwater lighting conditions make it impossible to resolve individual small scales; the texture appears smooth due to distance/focus.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Dorsal fin with numerous elongated venomous spines that fan outward like mane.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The dorsal spines are clearly visible extending upward from the back, appearing sharp and distinct.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large fan-like pectoral fins with elongated rays.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The pectoral fins are fully spread, showing the characteristic fan shape and separated bony rays.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Pelvic fins also with elongated spines.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The ventral/pelvic fins are visible beneath the body, showing the expected elongated spine structure.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The background coral has a slightly 'smudged' or painterly texture common in AI-generated underwater scenes, lacking the crisp micro-details of real macro photography. There is slight bleeding between the fin edges and the background.

artifact_observations.location: Tip of the right pectoral fin
artifact_observations.reasoning: The very tips of the elongated rays on the right-side pectoral fin seem to dissolve into the background rather than ending in a sharp point, suggesting minor generation instability at fine extremities.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific species identification and rule out generic fish hallucinations.
To verify the structural integrity of the complex, thin fin rays and check for fusion artifacts against the background.
To assess the realism of the underwater lighting and texture consistency.

focus_areas: Integrity of elongated fin rays (no melting/fusion)
Consistency of stripe patterns across body and fins
Realism of underwater depth of field and lighting
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the tips of the pectoral fin rays. In AI images, these often blur or merge with the background. Verify if the stripes on the body align logically with the underlying anatomy. Check if the dorsal spines have realistic thickness and opacity.
